goal: Review Java code for null handling, resource cleanup, concurrency, serialisation and input handling.
use: Review Java code for null handling, resource cleanup, concurrency, serialisation and input handling. Use when asked to review or harden a Java project or module.

steps.note: Read the project setup. Open the build file, the Java version and the lint and static analysis configuration.
Check null handling. Flag values from maps, optionals used with get(), and methods that can return null without saying so.
Check resources. Streams, connections and readers must close, normally through try-with-resources.
Check concurrency. Flag shared mutable state without synchronisation, and thread pools created per request.
Check input and serialisation. Flag untrusted data passed to deserialisation, to shell commands, or into SQL built as strings.
Report. List each finding with its file and line, severity and the fix.
